rows.Origin: Bred by Francois Dorieux II (1955-2015) (France, before 2001).
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red, golden-yellow reverse. Mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), high-centered bloom form.
rows.Habit: Tall, upright. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders or cut flower.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Internal breeder code: 4-699-81. No. 049 in the 2001 Monza Competition (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli).
